content.json:
## Retail Data Pipeline — Operations Dashboard

Monitors ADF pipeline runs, ingestion volumes by source, sales KPIs (gold layer), and resource health.

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DATAFACTORY"
| where Category == "PipelineRuns"
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Total = count(), Succeeded = countif(status_s == "Succeeded"), Failed = countif(status_s == "Failed"), Cancelled = countif(status_s == "Cancelled")
| extend SuccessRate = round(100.0 * Succeeded / Total, 1)
content.title: Pipeline run summary (24h)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DATAFACTORY"
| where Category == "PipelineRuns"
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Runs = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), status_s
| render timechart
content.title: Pipeline runs over time (success vs failure)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DATAFACTORY"
| where Category == "ActivityRuns"
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where activityName_s has_any ("Copy", "Ingest")
| summarize CopyDurationSec = avg(todouble(duration_s)) by pipelineName_s, activityName_s
| order by CopyDurationSec desc
| take 20
content.title: Ingestion activity duration by pipeline

content.query:
let sources = dynamic(["pos_transactions", "products", "customers", "inventory", "stores"]);
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DATAFACTORY"
| where Category == "ActivityRuns"
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where activityName_s has "Copy"
| extend source = case(
    pipelineName_s has "pos", "POS (SQL)",
    pipelineName_s has "product", "Products (Blob)",
    pipelineName_s has "customer", "Customers (REST)",
    pipelineName_s has "inventory", "Inventory (Postgres)",
    pipelineName_s has "store", "Stores (Cosmos)",
    "Other")
| summarize RowsCopied = sum(todouble(rowsCopied_d)), Runs = count() by source
| order by RowsCopied desc
content.title: Ingestion volumes by retail source
Sales KPIs — gold fact_sales (sample / post-pipeline)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.STORAGE"
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where MetricName in ("Transactions", "Ingress", "Egress", "SuccessE2ELatency")
| summarize avg(Average) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), MetricName
| render timechart
content.title: Storage account health (lake + sources)

content.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.DATAFACTORY"
| where Category == "PipelineRuns"
| where status_s == "Failed"
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, pipelineName_s, runId_g, failureType_s, message
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50
content.title: Recent pipeline failures
